# Cameo — account brief

## Who

Cameo is a marketplace for personalized celebrity video messages, described on its homepage as "Personalized videos from your favorite stars — Book personalized video messages from actors, athletes, musicians, and other celebrities." ([source](https://cameo.com/)). Its GitHub org profile lists the company as Cameo at cameo.com ([source](https://github.com/cameo)).

## Production Expo signals

- `eas.json` is present in `cameo/cameo-app` ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app/blob/main/eas.json)).
- `package.json` pins react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app/blob/main/package.json)).
- The repo has CI workflows under `.github/workflows` ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)).
- The org has 31 public repos and 240 followers ([source](https://github.com/cameo)).
- `cameo/cameo-app` was last pushed 2026-08-12 ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app)).
- The iOS app has 95,000 App Store ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cameo-personal-videos/id1258790408)).
- There were 4 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cameo-personal-videos/id1258790408)).

## Who to talk to

- Maintainer One (@cameo-maintainer-1), top contributor to `cameo/cameo-app` with 203 commits ([source](https://github.com/cameo-maintainer-1)). Profile lists company "Cameo", location "Remote", website https://cameo.com, and bio "Mobile engineer at Cameo. Maintains the Cameo app (Expo / React Native)." ([source](https://github.com/cameo-maintainer-1)).
- Maintainer Two (@cameo-maintainer-2), 151 commits ([source](https://github.com/cameo-maintainer-2)). Profile lists company "Cameo", location "New York, NY", website https://cameo.com, and bio "React Native developer on the Cameo mobile team. EAS builds and releases for the Cameo app." ([source](https://github.com/cameo-maintainer-2)).
- Maintainer Three (@cameo-maintainer-3), 77 commits ([source](https://github.com/cameo-maintainer-3)). Profile lists company "Cameo", location "San Francisco, CA", website https://cameo.com, and bio "Engineer at Cameo. Mostly the Cameo app, sometimes the API." ([source](https://github.com/cameo-maintainer-3)).

## Why now

The app shipped 4 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cameo-personal-videos/id1258790408)), and the repo was last pushed 2026-08-12 ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app)). It runs react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app/blob/main/package.json)).

## Suggested opener

Maintainer One, your profile says you maintain the Cameo app on Expo / React Native ([source](https://github.com/cameo-maintainer-1)), and you have 203 commits to `cameo/cameo-app` ([source](https://github.com/cameo-maintainer-1)). The repo has an `eas.json` ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app/blob/main/eas.json)) alongside CI workflows in `.github/workflows` ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)), and the app shipped 4 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cameo-personal-videos/id1258790408)). Across those four releases, what does the handoff between your `.github/workflows` CI and the EAS build in `eas.json` look like today?
